en.title: Illegal cosmetic advertising dataset
en.description: This dataset is extracted from the records of cosmetics advertisements filed by various county and city health bureaus. The displayed fields are limited to those open to the system, but the dataset may change due to subsequent revisions. This does not necessarily mean that the products of the subject of sanctions are illegal. Please use caution when referring to it.
en.notes: URL of API documentation that complies with OAS standard: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId158
